text: Implemented pure ArchiveRevision/publication state, closed canonical values, Resource[EitherT] OpenArchive, typed PayloadPlan/PayloadExecutor, structural/content validation, and additive eager LNA-HDF5 plus portable async Zarr drivers. HDF5 reports WholePayload; Zarr instruments actual reads and preserves ordered ranges 0+132 and 132+248 with 380 physical bytes, mixed-axis locality, and explicit single-request ordering. Resource release is tested on success, typed failure, and cancellation on JVM and Scala.js. Unknown representation and incomplete publication remain distinct. Final audit corrected physical-object checksum evidence so it does not overclaim logical-payload verification. Evidence: archiveJVM 53, archiveJS 35, archiveZarrJVM 17, archiveZarrJS 15; compileAll testAll passed; Phase-0 receipt/corpus verifier passed; git diff --check and escape-hatch scan passed. No general tensor or response scalar parameter was introduced.
